alex.s: Quick Q — where's the authoritative Grafana/dashboard for KV/prefix cache hit-rate? Prod had a bunch of misses and we got pages last night, want to find root cause and tune alerts.

maria_r: Dash lives under Infra -> KV Cache (prefix) in Grafana. Link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/kvcache/kv-prefix-cache?orgId=1 
Panels to check: 
  - hit_rate (per-prefix)
  - miss_rate
  - p99_latency_ms
  - top-prefixes-by-requests

PromQL snippets (use in Grafana queries):
```
sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))
sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_cache_misses_total[5m]))
```

Also Loki quicklogs: https://loki.redwood.net/explore?orgId=1&query=%7Bcomponent%3D%22kv-cache%22%7D

sam_k: Oncall saw an alert fired: `kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.12 for 3m` (page). Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/kvcache-runbook. I can handle a tuning PR if someone proposes thresholds and rollback steps.

alex.s: Nice, thx. Any tracing to correlate misses -> backend latency? Want to join logs/traces to see if misses line up with backend timeouts.

maria_r: Tempo traces: https://tempo.redwood.net/explore?query=service%3Dkv-cache. Look at spans named `kv.fetch` and `upstream.call` and group by `prefix` tag. For Loki use: `
{component="kv-cache"} |~ "prefix=\"(?P<prefix>[^\"]+)\"" | json | line_format "%{prefix} %{req_id} %{upstream_ms}"
`
Also, if you want a one-off panel to correlate traces+logs+metrics, duplicate the `hit_rate` panel and add `prefix` label on the query.

sam_k: Note about alerting: miss rate alone is noisy for high-traffic small prefixes. Suggest paging on a combined rule: page when `kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.20` AND `avg_over_time(kv_cache_p99_latency_ms[5m]) > 200`. Keep warning for `> 0.12` so devs see the trend but oncall isn't paged.

ops-oncall: :wave: happy to pair on the PR and run the test in staging. If we change thresholds, please add a test alert (firing) in staging and update the runbook with rollback steps + who to call.

alex.s: I'll open PR #987 with proposed changes: warning @ 0.12 (channel only), page @ 0.20 + p99 guard, and will include grafana links + runbook updates. tagging @maria_r for dashboard ownership. :thumbsup:

maria_r: SGTM. In the PR also add a screenshot of the affected panels and listing of top 5 prefixes that contribute to misses (so SREs can decide if we need cache-policy changes). If anyone's changing routing/fallback, note that in the PR too.
